main.description: A DRY-RUN mirror social-post OBSERVING the documented historical influence of a public figure / document / event / tradition (tsumugi diachronic extension, ADR-2606061500; built on the entity-as-actor mirror ADR-2606042330 + feed-post membrane ADR-2605231902). N2 mirror-only: the post is an OBSERVATION ABOUT a node's influence, NEVER the figure speaking — 'voice' is const 'observer' so first-person/impersonation is unrepresentable. N3 non-eschatological: it narrates the INFLUENCE OF a tradition, never its theological truth; no verdict/salvation field exists. Body is Murakumo-narrated (G6). LIVE firehose publication is Council + operator gated (G7); R0 = dry-run only ('published' false).

aboutNode.description: the historical node this post OBSERVES (e.g. 'fig.jesus', 'doc.torah') — observed, never authored-as

aboutFlow.description: optional :flow/* influence edge this post narrates (e.g. 'fl.paul.luther')

voice.description: N2 — LOCKED to observer. There is no 'first-person' value; the figure never speaks. Impersonation is structurally unrepresentable.

isMirror.description: N2 — a mirror of documented influence, never the person/text itself

narrator.description: G6 — narration is Murakumo-only; no vendor/off-Murakumo inference

disclaimer.description: REQUIRED — must open the rendered text, e.g. '観察像 — 本人ではない (an observational mirror, not the person)'

asOf.description: the diachronic anchor (era/year) this observation pertains to — history, not now (N3 非終末論)

published.description: G7 — false at R0 (dry-run); true only after Council + operator gate for live firehose

text.description: third-person observation; opens with disclaimer; aggregate-first, :representative-honest
